Usage:  circleci runner config <resource-class> [flags]

Flags:
  -h, --help                       help for config
      --name string                Runner name, machine only (default: hostname)
      --nickname string            Nickname for the new token
  -o, --output string              Write config to this file instead of stdout
      --product string             Runner product: machine|container|provisioner (default machine, prompts when unset)
      --token string               Use an existing token value instead of creating a new one
      --working-directory string   Job working directory, machine only
